einzeiler: Two penetration testers revisit their arrest during an authorized courthouse security…
kurzfassung: Two penetration testers were arrested during a legitimate physical security assessment of an Iowa courthouse and faced felony charges. After enduring imprisonment and a lengthy legal battle, they filed a civil rights lawsuit against the county. The case ultimately concluded with a significant settlement and established legal precedent for the cybersecurity industry.
stichpunkte: Penetration testers Justin Wynn and Gary DeMercurio were hired by the Iowa Judicial Branch to test the physical security of multiple government facilities.
During an authorized nighttime test at the Dallas County Courthouse, an alarm triggered and local law enforcement responded.
Despite presenting authorization documents and contacting state officials, the local sheriff insisted on arresting the testers for burglary.
The testers spent a night in jail wearing prison jumpsuits and faced high bail amounts and felony charges carrying up to seven years in prison.
Although the county eventually dropped the criminal charges after months of pressure, the arrest records remained on their files.
The cybersecurity community rallied in support, organizing an educational conference in the town to explain legitimate penetration testing.
Justin and Gabby launched a civil rights lawsuit against the county and the sheriff's position, refusing early low-ball settlement offers.
The long legal battle concluded with a successful settlement, providing financial compensation and legal precedent protecting penetration testers.

clips.text: The vast majority of commercial facilities can be entered simply by manipulating the door latch directly.
The sheriff dismissed the valid state contract, arguing that the state government lacked ownership authority over the local building.
The security professionals suddenly found themselves facing severe felony charges and potential prison time.

clips.hook: You can introduce me as the bad guy
clips.text: The sheriff humorously accepted the villain role when introduced at a cybersecurity conference held in the town.
The county ultimately resolved the civil lawsuit right before trial by agreeing to a substantial financial payout.

beschreibung:
In this episode we follow up with Gabby and Justin from Episode 59 - two seasoned penetration testers who tell us a story about the time when they tried to break into a courthouse but it went all wrong, and what happened in the aftermath.
